Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json,numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
print(sorted(G))

# New rule from verified diffs:
# 1. line = full uniform row/col of a single non-bg color (demo3 line is a COLUMN; demo1/2 rows)
# 2. bg = most common color. Structural cell: color!=bg and color!=line_color AND has a neighbor whose color differs (i.e. patterned/has a hole).
#    Object = connected component (4-dir) of structural cells that contains >=1 structural cell.
# 3. Move object perpendicular toward line until nearest edge is adjacent; 8-line/col placed just beyond the FAR edge (away from line), same side.
def f(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    cnt=Counter(g.flatten().tolist()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find line
    hline=None; vline=None
    for ii in range(H):
        s=set(g[ii].tolist())
        if len(s)==1 and next(iter(s))!=bg: hline=(ii,next(iter(s)))
    for jj in range(W):
        s=set(g[:,jj].tolist())
        if len(s)==1 and next(iter(s))!=bg: vline=(jj,next(iter(s)))
    lc=hline[1] if hline else vline[1]
    axis='h' if hline else 'v'
    pos=(hline[0],) if hline else (vline[0],)
    line=pos[0]
    
    def struc(i,j):
        c=int(g[i][j])
        if c==bg or c==lc: return False
        nb=[g[i+di][j+dj] for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))]
        return any(nb)!=c
    marks=[[struc(i,j) for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    # components of marked cells
    vis=np.zeros_like(marks,dtype=bool)
    comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if marks[i][j] and not vis[i][j]:
                stack=[(i,j)]; vis[i][j]=True; comp=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b,int(g[a][b])))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and marks[x][y] and not vis[x][y]:
                            vis[x][y]=True; stack.append((x,y))
                comps.append(comp)
    obj=comps[0]
    lo=min(i for i,j,v in obj); hi=max(i for i,j,v in obj)
    loj=min(j for i,j,v in obj); hij=max(j for i,j,v in obj)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='h':
        if hi<=line:   # above: top edge? nearest edge = top (lo); move down so lo->line-1
            off=line-1-lo
        else:           # below: nearest = bottom (hi); move up so hi->line+1
            off=line+1-hi
        nrs=[i+off for i,j,v in obj]
        nlo=nmin_=[min(nrs); ]
        near=min(nrs); far=max(nrs)
        r8=far+1 if hi<=line else near-1
        for i,j,v in obj: out[i+off][j]=v
        for j in range(W): out[r8][j]=8
    else:
        if hij<=line:   # left: move right so hij->line-1
            off=line-1-hij
        else:
            off=line+1-loj
        ncl=[j+off for i,j,v in obj]
        near=min(ncl); far=max(ncl)
        c8=far+1 if hij<=line else near-1
        for i,j,v in obj: out[i][j+off]=v
        for i in range(H): out[i][c8]=8
    return out

ok=True
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    a=np.array(f(G[p+' input'])); b=np.array(G[p+' output'])
    m=np.array_equal(a,b)
    ok&=m
    print(p,'match:',m)
    if not m:
        for r,c in np.argwhere(a!=b): print('  ',int(r),int(c),int(a[r,c]),int(b[r,c]))
print('ALL:',ok)
res=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps([[int(v) for v in r] for r in res]))

import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def comps_of(g, lc, bg):
    # structural: color != bg and != line color, with >=1 neighbor differing from it (a hole/marker inside)
    H,W=g.shape
    vis=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            c=g[i,j]
            if c!=bg and c!=lc and g[i-1,j]!=c or False: pass
            nb=[g[a,b] for a,b in ((i+1,j),(i-1,j),(i,j+1),(i,j-1)) if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W]
            if c!=bg and any(x!=c for x in nb) and not vis[i,j]:
                vis[i,j]=True; st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b,int(g[a,b])))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=W and True and g[x,y]!=g[a,b] and g[x,y]!=bg and not vis[x,y]:
                            vis[x,y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    cnt=Counter(g.flatten().tolist()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cand=[]
    for ii in range(H):
        s=set(g[ii]); 
        if len(s)==1 and next(iter(s))!=bg: cand.append(('h',ii,next(iter(s))))
    for jj in range(W):
        s=set(g[:,jj])
        if len(s)==1 and next(iter(s))!=bg: cand.append(('v',jj,next(iter(s))))
    line=cand[0]; axis=line[0]; lc=line[2]; lo=line[1]
    objs=comps_of(g,lc,bg)
    if not objs: return None
    obj=objs[0]
    if axis=='h':
        loo=lo; ls=min(i for i,j,v in obj); hs=max(i for i,j,v in obj)
        # move toward line
        if hs>loo:  # below: top edge -> line+1
            off=loo+1-ls; far=hs+off
            r8=fs=hs+off+1  # far+1 away from line (down)
        else:       # above: bottom -> line-1
            off=loo-1-hs; far=ls+off
            r8=far-1  # far-1 (up)
        # actually use offset from line: distance = extent+1 on far side
        if hs>loo:  # object below line, far side = below
            dist=(hs-loo)+2   # from line row to far edge inclusive offset
            r8=loo+dist
        else:
            dist=(loo-ls)+1
            r8=loo-dist
        out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
        for i,j,v in obj: out[i+off][j]=v
        for j in range(W): out[r8][j]=8
    else:
        loo=lo; ls=min(j for i,j,v in obj); ws=max(j for i,j,v in obj)
        if ws>loo:
            off=loo+1-ws; fs=ws+off
            c8=loo+(ws-loo)+2
        else:
            off=loo-1-ls; fs=ls+off
            c8=loo-(ls-loo)-2
        out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
        for i,j,v in obj: out[i][j+off]=v
        for i in range(H): out[i][c8]=8
    return out

for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    a=np.array(solve(G[p+' input'])); b=np.array(G[p+' output'])
    print(p,'match:',np.array_equal(a,b))
res=solve(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps([[int(v) for v in r] for r in res]))

        for i,j,v in obj: out[i][j+off]=v

import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    cnt=Counter(g.flatten().tolist()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lines=[]
    for ii in range(H):
